concerns.text: The recursive CTE in FeatureRepository uses native PostgreSQL SQL, which requires PostgreSQL datastore runtime environment.
Fallback handling suppresses 500 error logs when LMS is unreachable, returning 401 instead.
Document type filtering is performed at the service layer rather than in the repository database query.
Tokens are passed as query parameters in the 302 redirect location header during LTI launch.
Schema migration adds new telemetry fields without backfilling default values for historical records.
